versions.subject: Merge PR #5489 from @hashdr1ft - Suspicious Download and Execute Pattern via Curl/Wget
versions.detection:
selection_downloader:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/curl'
        - '/wget'
selection_tmp:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/tmp/'
        - '/dev/shm/'
selection_executor:
    CommandLine|contains: 'sh -c'
condition: all of selection_*
